## Perplexity setup

Connect a Header Auth credential in Perplexity Request: header name Authorization, value Bearer followed by your API key. Keep the key in the credential. An account with API credits is required. Edit the research question, system instructions, and domains in Set Params.

## Search settings

Uses the Sonar-compatible synchronous completion route, with selected domains and a month publication-recency filter. The service may rewrite legacy requests to newer models. Inspect returned citation URLs and verify generated claims.
